title: 2029 AMC 8 Problems
text:
The 2029 AMC 8 is an upcoming international math competition run by MAA AMC. It is expected to take place sometime in January or February 2029. Many countries participate, and the contest has not been released yet, so please do not post or trust any fake problems or solutions.

Based on past years, here are the expected award ranges:

Perfect Score: 25 points

Honor Roll of Distinction (DHR): usually around 23+

Honor Roll (HR): usually around 20+

Achievement Roll (AR): 15+, but only for 6th grade and below

School awards typically follow these ranges:

School Excellence Award: top three students total around 66+

School Meritorious Award: top three students total around 50–65
